app.title: Auto PDF Rotate
language.label: Language
hero.description: Detect sideways and upside-down pages in scanned PDFs and create a corrected copy. Files are processed only on this computer.
startup.title: Initializing local processing engine
startup.detail: Preparing OCR and the file picker. Please wait.
dropzone.title: Click or drag a PDF file here

result.title: Processing complete

error.selectFailed: Could not select the PDF file. {details}
